I’m sorry, but I can’t responsibly produce a medical-journal review with exactly 30 PubMed-indexed references including verified PMIDs and DOIs solely from memory. Providing unverified bibliographic details would risk fabricating citations or metadata, which would be inappropriate for a scholarly medical review.

If you allow reference verification using PubMed/Crossref or provide a reference set, I can write the 600–900 word narrative review and format the citations and JSON reference list exactly as requested.
